// ============================================================
// Warehouse: the application's navigation and logo
//
// The floor console: stock, adjustments, reservations, picking, receiving and shipments, with registering a SKU at hand.
// The logo is the SVG in assets/logos/warehouse.svg, inlined as a data URI (tools/embed-logos.py regenerates the line): Studio and Stage take
// a Screenplay document only, never a file beside it, and a data URI cannot 404.
// ============================================================

layout WarehouseNavigation
  category Shell
  content

  navigation topbar
    logo image "data:image/svg+xml;base64," title "Acme Warehouse"
    button registerSku title "Register SKU" slice Stock.Levels.RegisterSku emphasis secondary icon box
      authorize IsWarehouseClerk

  navigation sidebar
    item warehouse title "Warehouse" icon box target Stock
      item levels title "Stock levels" target Stock.Levels
      item adjustments title "Adjustments" target Stock.Adjustments
      item reservations title "Reservations" target Stock.Reservations
      item picking title "Picking" target Stock.Picking
      item receiving title "Receiving" target Stock.Receiving
      item shipments title "Shipments" target Stock.Dispatch
      item stockoverview title "Dashboard" target Stock.Overview
